mechanism: Extend compact MLA's persistent post-score Metal compute ICB to replay fixed-grid radix top-k before compact attention and the residual add after o_proj. Full-indexer layers replay seven commands; shared-indexer layers replay six commands and consume the rank already produced by the shared path.

scope.wait_count_claim: UNCHANGED: radix, compact attention, o_proj, and residual replay remain inside the existing token command buffer and commit boundary.

dynamic_scalars: radix active score count and selected count on full-indexer layers
ranked-attention active key count and selected count
graph_contract.sole_uncaptured_attention_command: gravity_glm_dsa_scores at the exact active n_keys grid on full-indexer layers

persistent_replay_contract.cache_extent: one lazy post-score graph slot per transformer layer
persistent_replay_contract.capture_key: layer, attention and hidden geometry, exact scale bits, projection metadata, radix and residual inclusion, and all bound cache, score, rank, query, weight, output, and residual GPU addresses
persistent_replay_contract.address_or_geometry_changes: rebuild only the affected layer graph
persistent_replay_contract.score_capacity_growth: reject reuse when active n_keys exceeds the captured score buffer capacity; an address change rebuilds the affected graph
persistent_replay_contract.residual_extent_validation: hidden float elements must fit the bound residual buffer
persistent_replay_contract.o_proj_validation: o_proj row count must equal hidden width
barriers: radix rank output before ranked attention
compact append before absorbed key/value consumers

qualified: Full-indexer post-score work from radix rank through the attention residual now replays as one persistent seven-command real Metal ICB per layer.
Shared-indexer layers replay the corresponding six-command compact-attention-through-residual graph without duplicating rank selection.
Dynamic n_keys, n_allow, and position updates reuse the captured graph without per-token buffer allocation.
Low-level native-BF16 evidence and direct-u8 PQ complete-token evidence are bit-exact to direct encoding.
not_qualified: One exact active-length DSA score dispatch remains direct on every full-indexer layer.

The attention prelude, indexer transforms, post-score work, expert waves, and final head are separate cached replay graphs; this tranche does not claim that host replay sequencing overhead is eliminated.
No latency, TPS, TTFT, bytes-per-token, command-buffer reduction, sealed-model, sustained-context, memory-pressure, swap, or thermal claim is made.
No sealed Math-Preserve execution occurred because valid MOP clearance is still absent.
qualification.next_boundary: Measure bounded direct-versus-replay encode and execution costs, then collapse replay-subgraph launch sequencing only where the evidence shows a net gain while preserving the exact-length direct DSA score boundary.
